title: tree-keeper's in
description: What the main conversation gives the tree-keeper: its run values as it starts, and each decision of the orchestrator's as it resumes it. tree-keeper.md names this file, and the guard limits the tree-keeper's calls to the run values.

start.description: The run values, one JSON object on the first line of the prompt that starts the role, as the guard gives it from tree.py's cut, each one a value that the guard limits the role's calls to.

record.description: The path of the role's record, a file in the run's folder `records/` that the role writes only by record.py add, in the form of record.schema.json, and that rn's check reads at the role's end.

run.description: The run's folder, `.rn/<yyyymmdd>-<goal>`, from the root of the run's worktree.

tree.description: The path of the run's design tree, `design-tree.json` in the run's folder, in the form of design-tree.schema.json.

cut.description: The path of the tree-keeper's cut, the file that tree.py cut wrote in the run's folder, which rn's check reads at its end.

resume.description: The message by which the main conversation resumes the role with SendMessage: its first line, then its decision on the role's last result and why, and, where the user answered, a line that opens the user's words as they wrote them, because a summary loses what the user meant.
